text:
kevin: Heads-up: UX review for alert composer tomorrow. Main open items: threshold grammar, collapsed destinations, and suppression labeling.
maya: For threshold grammar, can we show a contextual helper for ratio vs absolute metrics. Eg: '5% of requests' vs '5 requests per minute'. People confuse percent of errors vs absolute counts.
ori: Agreed. Maybe add a little small 'metric type' chip next to the threshold that says 'rate / count / latency' so the helper can adjust copy.
sylvia: Accessibility note: the destination chips need keyboard focus states and descriptive aria-labels. e.g. `<button aria-label="Send to PagerDuty (escalation: on)">PD</button>`.
build-bot: build: feat/alert-composer updated, lint OK, snapshots changed.
kevin: Suppression naming again: we used 'Quiet window' previously; legal flagged it. what's concise and clear? 'Silence for...' vs 'Pause notifications for...'.
maya: 'Silence for' reads odd. 'Pause notifications for' is explicit. Also need to call out scope inline: 'pause notifications for this rule' small gray text.
ori: UX microcopy: compact preview when destinations collapsed should show 'Sends to: PD, #ops, email' not icons only. Icons are fine but text helps new users.
sylvia: For long rule names truncated with ellipses, provide a copy tooltip that doesn't rely solely on title attribute (use aria-describedby).
build-bot: integration-tests: collapsed-preview-roles -> FAIL. Missing sample message for collapsed group.
kevin: Let's add the sample notification string generation to the composer: simple template `[{LEVEL}] {service} - {short message}`. Should be deterministic.
maya: Also think about localization: 'for 5 minutes' vs 'during 5 minutes' in other langs. Keep phrase simple.
ori: Suggestion: default microcopy: 'Notify if {metric} exceeds {threshold} for {duration}'. Using 'exceeds' avoids symbol parsing.
sylvia: Contrast check: small helper text inside pills is barely readable on light backgrounds. increase token opacity to 0.9.
build-bot: CI: feat/alert-composer -> all green after fix.
kevin: OK will update figma and add to QA checklist: keyboard nav, aria-live on sample preview, pill contrast, metric chip. Thanks team.
